Exported Functions

group LPN_Exported_Functions

Functions

bool lpn_init(uint8_t fn_num, pf_lpn_cb_t pf_lpn_cb)

Initialize the Low Power Node (LPN).

A LPN can establish multiple friendships on different NetKeys. This function initializes the LPN and configures it for maximum support for friend nodes (FN) interactions.

参数:

  • fn_num -- [in] Maximum supported FN number.

  • pf_lpn_cb -- [in] Callback function for managing LPN friendship events.

返回值:

  • true -- Operation is successful.

  • false -- Operation failed due to invalid parameters or resource limitations.

返回:

Operation result.

void lpn_deinit(void)

Deinitialize the LPN to release resources.

This function cleanly shuts down LPN operations and frees associated resources.

lpn_req_reason_t lpn_req(uint8_t frnd_index, uint16_t net_key_index, lpn_req_params_t *p_req_params)

Start to establish the friendship on the desired NetKey.

This function begins the process of establishing a friendship between the LPN and a FN using a specified network key index.

参数:

  • frnd_index -- [in] The FN index for establishing friendship.

  • net_key_index -- [in] The network key index used for the friendship.

  • p_req_params -- [in] Pointer to lpn_req_params_t specifying request parameters.

返回:

Operation result as reason for request handling.

bool lpn_clear(uint8_t fn_index)

Clear the friendship.

This function terminates the friendship with a specified FN by clearing associated data.

参数:

fn_index -- [in] The FN index to clear friendship.

返回值:

  • true -- Friendship successfully cleared if it existed.

  • false -- Friendship clearance failed.

返回:

Operation result.

frnd_offer_t lpn_get_frnd_offer(uint8_t fn_index)

Get friend offer information.

This function retrieves the friend offer information associated with the given FN index.

参数:

fn_index -- [in] The FN index.

返回:

The friend offer information for the specified FN.

bool lpn_set_frnd_offer(uint8_t fn_index, uint16_t net_key_index, uint16_t fn_addr, frnd_offer_t frnd_offer)

Set friend offer information.

This function sets the friend offer information for a specific FN index, adjusting LPN interaction parameters accordingly.

参数:

  • fn_index -- [in] The FN index.

  • net_key_index -- [in] The network key index.

  • fn_addr -- [in] The FN address in the network.

  • frnd_offer -- [in] Friend offer configuration details.

返回值:

  • true -- Local setting of friend offer is successful.

  • false -- Local setting of friend offer failed.

返回:

Success or failure of setting the friend offer.

uint16_t lpn_get_counter(uint8_t fn_index)

Get LPN counter.

Retrieves the current counter value for the LPN associated with the specified FN index.

参数:

fn_index -- [in] The FN index.

返回:

The LPN counter value.

bool lpn_set_counter(uint8_t fn_index, uint16_t lpn_counter)

Set LPN counter.

Allows configuration of the counter value for LPN interactions with the FN.

参数:

  • fn_index -- [in] The FN index.

  • lpn_counter -- [in] Counter value for LPN operations.

返回值:

  • true -- Local setting of LPN counter is successful.

  • false -- Local setting of LPN counter failed.

返回:

Success or failure of setting the LPN counter.

bool lpn_poll(uint8_t fn_index, uint32_t poll_interval)

Start friend poll.

Initiates a polling interaction with the friend node (FN) using specified intervals.

参数:

  • fn_index -- [in] The FN index.

  • poll_interval -- [in] Poll interval in units of 100 milliseconds.

返回值:

  • true -- Poll initiation is successful.

  • false -- Poll initiation failed.

返回:

Operation result.

int16_t lpn_get_frnd_idx(uint16_t net_key_index)

Get friend index from network key index.

Retrieves the friend index of a friendship established based on a network key index.

参数:

net_key_index -- [in] The network key index for friendship.

返回值:

  • >=0 -- Friend index.

  • <0 -- Friend not found.

返回:

The friend index.

void frnd_sub_list_add_rm(uint8_t fn_index, uint16_t addr[], uint8_t addr_num, bool add_rm)

Add or remove addresses from the subscription list.

Manages subscription addresses for an LPN when friendship with FN exists.

参数:

  • fn_index -- [in] The FN index.

  • addr -- [in] Array of subscription addresses.

  • addr_num -- [in] Number of addresses in the list.

  • add_rm -- [in] Flag to add (true) or remove (false) addresses from the list.
